source_provenance.oracle_correction: RequestTimings counts boarded requests. Include pending in final census. Original40 passing arms had zero pending, so their stricter check implies corrected check. Failed and67 unstarted arms rerun. Per-second safety checks and counts unchanged. Independent review map_provider READY. All input lane limits14m/s.

schedule_rosters.hash_recipe: SHA-256 of UTF-8 tick:origin>destination followed by newline per request; schedule ID is first 8 bytes in hexadecimal

candidate_selection.rule: All three screen seeds recover and improve lexicographic recovery count, unfinished count, longest elapsed run, then mean seed request-to-alight. Exploratory selection, not statistical significance. Test every qualifying candidate at the next tested nominal rate.

metrics_notes.time_unit: seconds unless field name specifies otherwise
metrics_notes.late_backlog_change: outstanding at minute 60 minus outstanding at minute 30
metrics_notes.wait_statistics: request to boarding, including elapsed pending waits
metrics_notes.journey_statistics: request to alight, completed requests only
metrics_notes.drain_seconds: 0 is a sentinel when drained is false
